items.desc_en: Fox has decided not to renegotiate its current TV deal with the NFL until the expiration of the league's opt-out clause in 2030, said CEO Lachlan Murdoch.
items.desc_zh: 首席执行官拉克兰·默多克 (Lachlan Murdoch) 表示，福克斯决定在 2030 年联盟的选择退出条款到期之前，不再与 NFL 重新谈判其当前的电视转播协议。
